# Generated by tools/lowbit_mma_speed/ptx_probe.sh. Compiles the int8 unit
# kernels for this device and dumps their PTX. Launches nothing.

from gemm.checks.gemm_int8_mma import identical_gemm_int8_mma_kernel

def stat_reference(ctx: DeviceContext) raises:
    comptime kern = identical_gemm_int8_mma_kernel
    var f = ctx.compile_function[kern, dump_asm=Path("/tmp/lowbit-mma-speed-ptx/dumps/reference.ptx")]()
    print(
        "PTX_PROBE label=reference",
        " regs=", f.get_attribute(Attribute.NUM_REGS),
        " local=", f.get_attribute(Attribute.LOCAL_SIZE_BYTES),
        " shared=", f.get_attribute(Attribute.SHARED_SIZE_BYTES),
        " threads=128",
        " blocks_per_multiprocessor=", f.occupancy_max_active_blocks_per_multiprocessor(128, 0),
        sep="",
    )

        " local=", f.get_attribute(Attribute.LOCAL_SIZE_BYTES),
        " shared=", f.get_attribute(Attribute.SHARED_SIZE_BYTES),
        " threads=128",
        " blocks_per_multiprocessor=", f.occupancy_max_active_blocks_per_multiprocessor(128, 0),
        sep="",
    )

def main() raises:
    var ctx = DeviceContext()
    try:
        stat_reference(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=reference error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_direct_reference_loads(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=direct_reference_loads error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_direct_aligned_loads(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=direct_aligned_loads error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_direct_scalar_acc(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=direct_scalar_acc error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_probe_loads_hoisted(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=probe_loads_hoisted error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_staged_w16_b32_k32_l4(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=staged_w16_b32_k32_l4 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_staged_w64_b128_k32_l4(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=staged_w64_b128_k32_l4 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_staged_w64_b128_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=staged_w64_b128_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_staged_w64_b128x256_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=staged_w64_b128x256_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_staged_w32_b64_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=staged_w32_b64_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_staged_w32_b128_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=staged_w32_b128_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_staged_w16x32_b128_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=staged_w16x32_b128_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_refused_w16x32_b64x256_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=refused_w16x32_b64x256_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_refused_w32_b128x256_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=refused_w32_b128x256_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_pieces_w16_b32_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=pieces_w16_b32_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_pieces_w16x32_b64x128_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=pieces_w16x32_b64x128_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_pieces_w32_b64x128_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=pieces_w32_b64x128_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_pieces_w16_b64_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=pieces_w16_b64_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_pieces_w16x32_b32x128_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=pieces_w16x32_b32x128_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_pieces_w16x32_b64x64_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=pieces_w16x32_b64x64_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_staged_w32_b256x64_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=staged_w32_b256x64_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_staged_w32_b512x32_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=staged_w32_b512x32_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_staged_w32x16_b512x16_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=staged_w32x16_b512x16_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_pieces_w16x32_b128x64_k32_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=pieces_w16x32_b128x64_k32_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_pieces_w16x32_b256x32_k32_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=pieces_w16x32_b256x32_k32_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_pieces_w16_b256x16_k32_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=pieces_w16_b256x16_k32_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_pieces_w16x32_b64x128_k32_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=pieces_w16x32_b64x128_k32_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_pipe2_w16x32_b64x128_k32_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=pipe2_w16x32_b64x128_k32_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_pipe2_w32_b64x128_k32_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=pipe2_w32_b64x128_k32_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_pipe2_w16_b32_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=pipe2_w16_b32_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_fused_w16x32_b64x128_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=fused_w16x32_b64x128_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_fused_w16_b32_k64_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=fused_w16_b32_k64_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_fused_pipe2_w16x32_b64x128_k32_l16(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=fused_pipe2_w16x32_b64x128_k32_l16 error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_quantize_reference(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=quantize_reference error=", e, sep="")
    try:
        stat_quantize_par_256(ctx)
    except e:
        print("PTX_PROBE_ERROR label=quantize_par_256 error=", e, sep="")
    print("PTX_PROBE_DONE")
